items.title: Google Unveils TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx: A Dual-Chip TPU and a Confidential TPU
items.summary: Google added TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx to its eighth-generation TPU lineup. TPU 8i Max packs 2 TPU 8i chips per package for long-context agents. TPU 8tx adds hardware confidential inference. Bloomberg reports 2027 availability. items.title: Baidu’s ERNIE Evolve Automated Research System Beats NanoChat and NanoGPT Records
items.summary: Baidu’s ERNIE Evolve is an automated research system that edits code, runs experiments and keeps only verified gains. It beat public bests on NanoChat and NanoGPT Speedrun and sped up ERNIE-5.5-Flash inference. items.title: Reason Machines Open-Sources Aspen, a Git Server Built for AI Agents
items.summary: Reason Machines has open-sourced Aspen, a self-hosted Git server for AI agents. It follows OpenAI’s Pando design and sustained 567 pushes per second on one 8-core server in the company’s own test.
